description: This Java source file defines an Android activity (`InstrumentationList`) that displays a list of instrumentation components related to the app, allows toggling profiling mode, and starts instrumentation tests on list item click. It includes an adapter class (`InstrumentationAdapter`) to manage and display instrumentation info.

classes.name: InstrumentationAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying instrumentation components in a list, sorting them, and providing views for each item.

classes.name: InstrumentationList
classes.description: Main activity class that displays the list of instrumentation components, manages profiling mode, and handles item clicks to start instrumentation tests.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the list adapter, and handles saved instance state regarding profiling mode.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with a profiling toggle item.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu by setting the check state of the profiling menu item.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, retrieves the instrumentation component, and starts it with optional profiling.
